correctness.rationale: For bracket [e1,e2]=e1 and induced ternary [[x,y],z], substitution of R=[[a,b],[c,d]] into the weight-mu binary Reynolds identity yields precisely a^2+bc+mu*a*(ad-bc)=0 and c*(a+d+mu*(ad-bc))=0, mu!=0. The source's induced-bracket example implies the ternary identity follows; independent symbolic verification checks this. If c=0, equations split into planes A:{a=c=0} and B:{c=0,d=-1/mu}; if c!=0, elimination gives detR=trR=0, hence R^2=0. N:{R^2=0} is the third component. Intersections A∩B and A∩N are distinct lines and B∩N empty. Every q-element field thus has 3q^2-2q solutions, ranks (1,2q^2-q-1,q(q-1)); conjugation by Aut(L)=[[s,t],[0,1]] gives 2q+2 orbit classes, orbit sizes and rational zeta as claimed. Independent enumeration of every 2x2 matrix and every nonzero weight over F2,F3,F5 verifies counts and automorphism orbits; arbitrary-field result follows by case split not enumeration.
